title: WildGraphBench: Benchmarking GraphRAG with Wild-Source Corpora
authors: Pengyu Wang; Benfeng Xu; Licheng Zhang; Shaohan Wang; Mingxuan Du; Chiwei Zhu; Zhendong Mao
why_relevant: Introduces a GraphRAG benchmark using heterogeneous, noisy wild-source corpora, touching on noise robustness and multi-document aggregation evaluation.
